Core proposition: I make businesses stand out from the sea of other businesses.

## Project status

The two featured project slots are explicitly labeled placeholders. Project 01 has the functional summary "Plumbing Company Site"; Project 02 has "Independent Studio Website". Their example.com links are not completed projects, client endorsements, or live work samples.

## Technical details

Static HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript. Work Sans is provided by Google Fonts. Locally hosted GSAP and ScrollTrigger provide motion. Reduced-motion preferences disable major movement and desktop wheel glide while retaining the word-by-word About color reveal. Core content remains warm near-black and readable without JavaScript. FormSubmit processes contact form submissions. The site is suitable for static hosting on Vercel.
